verdict.rationale: xAI's Batch API explicitly lets users 'process large volumes of requests asynchronously with reduced pricing and higher rate limits,' and the image generation API also supports 'batch generation of multiple images' — direct first-party support for bulk operations across many items. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of batch throughput or limits, and no documented batch size caps or bulk-specific rate limit details beyond the general rate-limits page.
